brief:
Three Palestinians have died in Gaza, among them a woman who succumbed to injuries she had sustained in an earlier attack, the Ma'an news agency reported. The fatalities represent a continuation of ongoing casualties in the enclave.

The circumstances surrounding the deaths and their specific location were not immediately disclosed in available reports. Ma'an did not specify when the woman had been initially wounded or provide further details about the other two individuals killed.
title: Three Palestinians killed in Gaza, including woman from prior wounds
